frog.method: Natural input/row-update traces. Crossing tests explicitly set head ($A2/$A3), decimal score and speed registers and clear the landing rows in LCD RAM; game code is unchanged.

beetle.method: Natural four-enemy updates. Hit probes explicitly construct one enemy, the gun and LCD target; original shooting code is unchanged.

dice.method: Execute unmodified pair-evaluation subroutine at $189B, bank 1, with all 1296 constructed $96..$99 four-die inputs. Zero-based face registers; return 0 = reroll, 255 = four equal, other returns add two. No whole-game timing claims.

audio.method: Execute the original HT4BITsound decoder with its configured sound ROM, 1 MHz clock and four-cycle sampling; one cycle of each channel.
